name: Kouseiin Shiori
source: pretty girl.Compared to Sati, she is a sensible person.But she is terrifyingly scary. She is a genuine young lady who was born into a venerable family on Earth.For a young lady, for some reason she is good at all household chores, and especially when it comes to cooking, she has a license and other skills. It is a complete mystery as to why she is stealing with Sati.
